name: sunset-fairy-castle-girl
image_purpose: Travel lifestyle post and theme-park fashion portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a playful golden-hour travel portrait of an approved adult woman posing before a fairytale castle at a theme park.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with soft natural makeup and a carefree tongue-out smile. She wears a white mesh tank layered over a secure black underlayer with a small kitten graphic and ATM letters, red athletic shorts, red shoulder bag, and simple jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait on a cobblestone walkway, pink and blue castle turrets behind, subject holding the bag strap and standing casually among visitors. Preserve the fun candid travel pose and colorful theme-park context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight, colorful castle reflections, soft shadows, shallow background depth, vibrant but realistic travel-photo color.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealism, natural skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A playful candid vertical theme-park portrait of one approved adult blonde woman with soft natural makeup and a carefree tongue-out smile, standing on a cobblestone walkway before a fairytale castle with pink and blue turrets. She wears a white mesh tank layered over a secure black underlayer with a small kitten graphic and ATM letters, red athletic shorts, red shoulder bag, and simple jewelry. Warm golden-hour sunlight, vibrant realistic colors, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, visitors and castle architecture behind, 35mm travel photography, natural skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain.
